store.yaml
  format: int

options.yaml (optional): the global Options; a key left out takes its default
  focus_clear: string (optional)
  focus_popup: string (optional)
  gh_path: string (optional)

projects/<key>/project.yaml
  key: string
  display_name: string
  created: string
  mode: string
  archived: string (optional)
  landing: mapping (optional)
      method: string
      push: bool
      remote: string
      land_per_spec: *bool (optional)
      pat_env: string (optional)
      base: string (optional)
  ci: mapping (optional)
      tracking: bool
      provider: string
      repository: string (optional)
      project_url: string (optional)
      pat_env: string (optional)
      ignored_workflows: []string (optional)
      push_remote_url: string (optional)
      push_remote_base: string (optional)
      rules: list of mappings (optional)
          spec: int
          workflow: string
          branch: string
          state: string
          created: string
      unblock_on_push: bool (optional)
  github_issues: mapping (optional)
      on: bool
      repository: string (optional)
      label: string (optional)
      new_issues_need_me: bool (optional)
      spec: int (optional)
  models: mapping (optional)
      default: mapping (optional)
          model: string (optional)
          effort: string (optional)
      kinds: list of mappings (optional)
          kind: string
          model: string (optional)
          effort: string (optional)
  reported_models: mapping (optional)
      effort_levels: []string (optional)
      aliases: []string (optional)
      model_ids: []string (optional)
      model_flag: string (optional)
      effort_flag: string (optional)
      reported: string (optional)
  stage_guides: mapping (optional)
      subagent_exploration_off: bool (optional)
      model_assignment_on: bool (optional)
  ci_responses: list of mappings (optional)
      commit: string
      land_anyway: string (optional)
      rerun: string (optional)
      reruns: list of mappings (optional)
          id: int64
          attempt: int
      fix_ticket: int (optional)
  ci_fixes_spec: int (optional)
  small_changes_spec: int (optional)

projects/<key>/specs/<n>.md: YAML frontmatter between --- lines, then the Markdown body
  id: int
  title: string
  labels: []string
  tags: map[string]string
  link: mapping (optional)
      integration: string
      id: string
      url: string (optional)
      external_state: string
      detached: bool (optional)
      outbound: bool (optional)
      written: []string (optional)
  created: string
  updated: string
  edits: list of mappings
      number: int
      actor: string
      time: string
      previous: map[string]string

projects/<key>/tickets/<n>.yaml
  title: string
  state: string
  spec: int
  labels: []string
  tags: map[string]string
  blocked_by: []int
  replacements: []int
  link: mapping (optional)
      integration: string
      id: string
      url: string (optional)
      external_state: string
      detached: bool (optional)
      outbound: bool (optional)
      written: []string (optional)
  awaiting_triage: bool (optional)
  spec_merge_ticket: bool (optional)
  created: string
  updated: string
  description: string
  branch: string (optional)
  commit: string (optional)
  recommendation: string (optional)
  pushed_commits: list of mappings (optional)
      commit: string
      branch: string (optional)
      pushed: string
      land_anyway: string (optional)
      rerun: string (optional)
      reruns: list of mappings (optional)
          id: int64
          attempt: int
  spec_merge: mapping (optional)
      commit: string
      merged: string
  pull_request: mapping (optional)
      number: int
      link: string
      state: string
      merge_commit: string (optional)
  claims: list of mappings
      number: int
      id: string
      session_id: string (optional)
      working_dir: string (optional)
      resume_command: string (optional)
      model: string (optional)
      effort: string (optional)
      started: string
      ended: string (optional)
      ended_by: string (optional)
  rounds: list of mappings
      number: int
      claim: int
      session_id: string (optional)
      posted: string
      questions: list of mappings
          number: int
          title: string
          body: string
          recommended: string (optional)
          status: string
          answer: string (optional)
          closed: string (optional)
  failure_reports: list of mappings
      number: int
      claim: int
      session_id: string (optional)
      working_dir: string (optional)
      resume_command: string (optional)
      actor: string
      time: string
      what_broke: string
      why: string
      what_to_fix: string
      where_work_stands: string
  comments: list of mappings
      number: int
      actor: string
      time: string
      claim: int (optional)
      body: string
  moves: list of mappings
      from: string (optional)
      to: string
      actor: string
      time: string
      claim: int (optional)
      via: string (optional)
      commit: string (optional)
  edits: list of mappings
      number: int
      actor: string
      time: string
      previous: map[string]string

projects/<key>/ci-runs.yaml (optional): the Project's CI Runs
  runs: list of mappings
      id: int64
      attempt: int
      workflow: string
      name: string
      branch: string
      commit: string
      status: string
      conclusion: string (optional)
      started: string (optional)
      finished: string (optional)
      url: string
      jobs: list of mappings (optional)
          name: string
          conclusion: string (optional)
          url: string
      ticket: int (optional)
      rule: int (optional)
      ignored: bool (optional)

values
  options focus_clear (default activity_dashboard): activity_dashboard, all_clear
  options focus_popup (default off): off, on
  project landing.method (no landing: merge, push false, remote origin): merge, branch, pull_request
  project ci.provider (no ci: tracking off, github_actions): github_actions, azure_pipelines
  project models.kinds[].kind: grilling, spec, tickets, map-chart, map-grilling, map-research, map-task, prototype, implementation
  ticket state, moves[].from, moves[].to: Draft, Ready, In Progress, Needs Answer, Answered, Failed, In Review, Accepted, Done, Cancelled
  ticket recommendation (optional): implement, split
  ci run status: queued, in_progress, completed
  ci run conclusion, jobs[].conclusion (optional): success, failure, cancelled, timed_out, skipped, neutral, partially_succeeded
  rounds[].questions[].status: open, answered, dismissed
  link.external_state: open, closed, deleted, out_of_scope
  spec edits[].previous keys: title, body, external_state, detached
  ticket edits[].previous keys: title, description, spec, external_state, detached
